incident.symptom: LinkedIn company publication could be blocked before provider dispatch because the content gate required a measurable /g/ link that the publisher itself did not create; provider create could also succeed while exact readback remained forbidden.
incident.root_cause: The publication path split responsibility across generation, measurement-link provisioning, provider dispatch and readback. A required precondition was enforced but not autonomously provisioned, and publish capability was not explicitly separated from readback capability.
incident.consequence: Daily publication could require manual repair even though all required data and mutation authority were already inside the canonical Powerhouse runtime.

root_cause: A mandatory /g/ CTA was validated by the content gate but had no same-lane self-healing producer.
LinkedIn write scopes and readback scopes were represented as one coarse readiness state.
Provider create success and provider truth verification require separate states to prevent duplicate recovery.
prevention: LINKEDIN_COMPANY_MEASURED_LINK_SELF_HEAL: before review, ensure bg_campaign_links contains one active li-company-YYYYMMDD key and bind the matching /g/ URL into the exact artifact.
LINKEDIN_PROVIDER_SIDE_EFFECT_IS_IRREVERSIBLE_FOR_DAILY_DEDUPE: any real post URN forces republish_forbidden=true for that run_date/channel.
PUBLISH_READY_AND_READBACK_READY_ARE_SEPARATE: missing r_member_social or r_organization_social may leave exact readback pending but must never trigger a replacement create.
DAILY_RECOVERY_REUSES_CANONICAL_LINEAGE: recover pre-provider failures on the same artifact, decision, capability authority and channel/date; no Buffer fallback for LinkedIn.
HOURLY_RECOVERY_WATCH_RECONCILES_WITHOUT_DUPLICATION: autonomous checks may repair only recoverable pre-side-effect failures or reconcile an existing external id.
